visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized digital graphic comparing 4G and 5G cellular towers against a clear sky, with yellow and blue signal lines radiating over a futuristic blue city. Large white text headers are fixed at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) A digital screenshot of a TVBS news report titled "「4G釘子戶」仍達1700萬人" is displayed, followed by a transition to a black background featuring a red, vibrating cartoon face showing expressions of intense anger with surrounding comic-style rage symbols. (3) A series of text bubbles representing netizen comments slide sequentially onto the screen over a backdrop of silver metal nails arranged on a wooden surface. A brief, historical clip of a man in a black turtleneck (Steve Jobs) holding an early smartphone appears in a small inset. (4) An aerial night shot of a sprawling metropolis is shown, featuring brightly lit skyscrapers and golden glowing street grids against the dark urban sky. (5) A middle-aged man in a blue button-down shirt is filmed in a medium shot against a neutral studio background, pointing his index finger upwards while a large white cartoon speech bubble with Chinese text appears near his head.

The music features a consistent synthesizer rhythm and a crisp digital pulse. A sharp digital "click" sound effect punctuates the transition of on-screen graphics. (2) As the news article appears, a distinct metallic scraping or "shink" sound effect, resembling metal nails, is heard alongside the narrator's high-arousal speech. The narrator maintains a professional yet animated tone, explaining the data while the electronic beat provides a steady, high-energy background layer. (3) A soft digital notification "ding" sounds as netizen comments are visually displayed. The narrator's pitch remains modulated and friendly, with his speech rate accelerating to match the visual information flow. The audio remains clean with no background environmental noise, emphasizing the synthesized BGM. (4) The primary narrator's voice concludes, transitioning to a deeper, more authoritative male voice with a slower, inquisitive speech pattern. The background music ducks in volume significantly, allowing the new speaker's voice to stand out as he asks a final question to the viewers.
